name: Cheesy Bean & Veggie-Loaded Enchiladas with Cucumber Salad & Hot Sauce
ingredients: to taste / see method olive oil
to taste / see method white wine vinegar
steps: Get prepped: Finely chop brown onion (see ingredients) and garlic. Thinly slice capsicum into strips. Drain and rinse red kidney beans. Drain sweetcorn.

Cook the filling: In a large frying pan, heat a drizzle of olive oil over medium-high heat. Cook capsicum, sweetcorn and half the onion, stirring, until softened, 4-5 minutes. Add All-American spice blend and half the garlic and cook until fragrant, 1 minute. Add the water, red kidney beans, the butter and half the diced tomatoes with garlic & onion. Season to taste with salt and pepper, then stir to combine. Simmer until the mixture is slightly thickened, 5 minutes.

Make the sauce: Meanwhile, in a small saucepan, heat a drizzle of olive oil over medium-high heat. Cook the remaining onion, stirring, until softened, 2-3 minutes. Add the remaining garlic and cook until fragrant, 1 minute. Stir in the remaining diced tomatoes and the brown sugar. Remove from heat, then season to taste.

Grill the enchiladas: Preheat the grill to high. Lay mini flour tortillas on a chopping board. Spoon some bean filling down the centre of the tortilla. Roll it up tightly and place, seam-side down, in a baking dish. Repeat with remaining tortillas and bean filling, ensuring the tortillas fit together snugly. Pour over the sauce, then sprinkle with Cheddar cheese. Grill the enchiladas until the cheese is melted and golden and the tortillas are warmed through, 8-10 minutes.

Make the salad: While the enchiladas are grilling, thinly slice cucumber into half-moons. In a medium bowl, combine the honey and a drizzle of white wine vinegar and olive oil. Season to taste, then add cucumber and mixed salad leaves. Toss to coat.

Finish & serve: Divide the cheesy bean and veggie-loaded enchiladas between plates. SPICY! Use less hot sauce if you’re sensitive to heat! Drizzle enchiladas with hot sauce and dollop with light sour cream. Serve with cucumber salad. Enjoy!
description: Enchiladas - what could be more fun? Make a tasty bean filling, roll it up in soft flour tortillas and then top the whole thing off with melted cheesy goodness. With a fresh side salad, this veggie meal is a winner.
proteinSwaps: BEEF MINCE: Cook with filling, breaking up with a spoon, until just browned, 3-4 minutes.
PORK MINCE: Cook with filling, breaking up with a spoon, until just browned, 3-4 minutes.
CHICKEN BREAST: Cut into 2cm chunks. Before starting the filling, cook until cooked through, 5-6 minutes.

name: Mild Indian Butter Chicken & Nutty Rice with Spinach & Garlic Tortillas
ingredients: to taste / see method olive oil
steps: Make the nutty rice: In a medium saucepan, add the water (for the rice) and bring to the boil. Add basmati rice. Stir, cover with a lid and reduce heat to low. Cook for 10 minutes, then remove pan from heat. Keep covered until rice is tender and water is absorbed, 10 minutes (the rice will finish cooking in its own steam!). When the rice has finished cooking, stir crushed peanuts and half the butter through the rice. Meanwhile, cut chicken thigh into 2cm chunks. In a medium bowl, combine mild North Indian spice blend, a drizzle of olive oil and a pinch of salt and pepper. Add chicken and toss to coat.

Make the curry: In a large frying pan, heat a drizzle of olive oil over high heat. Cook chicken, tossing occasionally, until browned and cooked through, 5-6 minutes. Reduce heat to medium-high, then add tomato paste, mild curry paste and half the garlic paste. Cook until fragrant, 1 minute. Add light cooking cream, the brown sugar and water (for the curry). Cook, stirring, until thickened, 2-3 minutes. Add baby spinach leaves and cook, stirring until wilted, 1 minute. TIP: Chicken is cooked through when it’s no longer pink inside.

Grill the garlic tortillas: While the chicken is cooking, preheat oven grill to high. In a small microwave-safe bowl, combine the remaining butter and remaining garlic paste. Microwave in 10 second bursts until fragrant and melted. Spread garlic butter over one side of the mini flour tortillas. Place tortillas directly on a wire oven rack. Grill until golden, 3-5 minutes.
Finish & serve: Divide mild Indian butter chicken and nutty rice between bowls. Serve with garlic tortillas. Enjoy!
description: Thanks to our mild North Indian spice blend and curry paste, you can whip up this crowd-pleasing butter chicken in less time than it would take to order and wait for takeaway. Complete the dish with baked tortillas for scooping and peanut rice for crunch.
proteinSwaps: CHICKEN BREAST: Cut into 2cm chunks. Cook until cooked through, 5-6 minutes.
PEELED PRAWNS: Bring curry to a simmer, add prawns and cook until pink and starting to curl up, 3-4 minutes. Add a splash of water if necessary!
CHICKEN THIGH: Follow method above, cooking in batches if necessary.

name: Lemon Pepper Salmon & Sautéed Greens with Hot Honey Drizzle
ingredients: to taste / see method olive oil
to taste / see method chilli flakes s
steps: Get prepped: Chop broccoli (including stalk!) into small florets. Zest lemon to get a pinch and slice into wedges. Finely chop garlic. Thinly slice zucchini into sticks. Thinly slice kale, discarding any larger pieces of stalk. In a medium bowl, combine salmon, lemon pepper seasoning and a drizzle of olive oil. Set aside.

Cook the veggies: In a large frying pan, heat a drizzle of olive oil over medium-high heat. Cook broccoli and zucchini, tossing until tender, 6-7 minutes (cook in batches if needed). Add kale and garlic and cook until softened and fragrant, 1-2 minutes. Transfer to a bowl, then add a generous squeeze of lemon juice. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Cover to keep warm. TIP: Add a dash of water to the pan to help speed up the cooking process.
description: You’ve now arrived at flavour central, the hub where we serve only the tastiest dishes from our hearts to your homes. The sautéed greens are proof of this mega flavour and when paired with some lemon pepper salmon and a spectacular hot honey drizzle, this dish is truly divine.

CHICKEN THIGH: Cut into 2cm chunks. Season as above. Cook until cooked through, 5-6 minutes.

Microwave in 10 second bursts until warmed through and fragrant. Set aside. HAVE A BBQ? Preheat BBQ to medium-high heat. name: Luxe Chicken & Bacon Pesto Fresh Fettuccine with Greens & Parmesan Cheese
ingredients: to taste / see method olive oil
steps: Get prepped & cook the chicken: Boil the kettle. Cut zucchini into bite-sized chunks. Cut chicken tenderloins into 2cm chunks. In a large frying pan, heat a drizzle of olive oil over medium-high heat. Cook diced bacon, breaking up with a spoon, until golden, 4-6 minutes. Add chicken and zucchini and cook, tossing occasionally, until chicken is browned and cooked through, 5-6 minutes. TIP: Chicken is cooked through when it’s no longer pink inside.

Cook the fettuccine: Half-fill a large saucepan with boiling water and add a generous pinch of salt. Cook egg fettuccine over high heat, until ‘al dente’, 2 minutes. Reserve some pasta water (see ingredients). Drain fettuccine, then return to the saucepan. TIP: ‘Al dente’ pasta is cooked through but still slightly firm in the centre.

Bring it all together: To the pan with chicken, add garlic paste and cook until fragrant, 1 minute. Stir in light cooking cream, stock concentrate and the reserved pasta water and cook until slightly thickened, 2-3 minutes. Add cooked pasta, baby spinach leaves and basil pesto, tossing to combine. Season to taste with pepper.
Finish & serve: Divide luxe chicken and bacon pesto fresh fettuccine between bowls. Top with Parmesan cheese to serve. Enjoy!

description: This comforting dish pairs tender chicken and bacon with a simple but stellar pesto sauce. The light zucchini and sharp Parmesan are perfect for balancing out the richness of the dish.

name: Express Cheesy BBQ Chicken Pita Pockets with Corn Cob, Cucumber Salad & Ranch
ingredients: to taste / see method olive oil
steps: Steam the corn: Cut corn cob in half. Transfer corn to a large microwave-safe plate. Cover with a damp paper towel. Microwave corn on high, until tender, 4-5 minutes. Drain any excess liquid, then season with salt and pepper. Cover to keep warm.

Cook the chicken: Meanwhile, in a large frying pan, heat a drizzle of olive oil over high heat. Cook chicken breast strips and Aussie spice blend tossing occasionally, until browned and cooked through (when no longer pink inside), 3-4 minutes. Remove pan from heat and add BBQ sauce and a splash of water, tossing until combined. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Toast the pita pockets & toss the salad Microwave pita bread on a plate for 1 minute, until warmed through. Halve pita bread and fill with BBQ chicken and Cheddar cheese. Heat pita bread in a sandwich press for 2-3 minutes, until cheese is melted. While pita pockets are toasting, thinly slice cucumber into rounds. In a medium bowl, combine cucumber, mixed salad leaves and a drizzle of olive oil and vinegar. Season to taste.
Finish & serve: Divide corn cob, cheesy BBQ chicken pita pockets and cucumber salad between plates. Drizzle ranch dressing over corn to serve. Enjoy!
description: Get ready for a family-favourite feast with these cheesy BBQ chicken pita pockets, packed with juicy chicken and melty cheese. Served with a golden corn cob and a refreshing cucumber salad, the creamy ranch sauce brings it all together for a seriously satisfying dinner. Cutlery optional!
proteinSwaps: BEEF STRIPS: Cook in batches, tossing, until browned and cooked through, 1-2 minutes.
BACON: Cook bacon, turning, until golden, 4-5 minutes. Add to pita pockets.
CHICKEN BREAST STRIPS: Follow method above, cooking in batches if necessary. 21 3 4

name: Herby Chicken & Honey-Balsamic Fioretto with Veggie Toss & Italian Truffle Mayo
ingredients: to taste / see method olive oil
to taste / see method balsamic vinegar
steps: Get prepped: Preheat oven to 240°C/220°C fan-forced. Cut potato and zucchini into bite-sized chunks. Slice brown onion (see ingredients) into thick wedges. Trim Fioretto and halve any thicker stalks lengthways.
Roast the veggies: Place potato, zucchini and onion on a lined oven tray. Drizzle with olive oil, season with salt and toss to coat. Roast until tender, 20-25 minutes.

Roast the Fioretto: When veggies have 15 minutes remaining, place Fioretto on a second lined oven tray. Drizzle with olive oil, season with salt and pepper and toss to coat. Roast until tender and browned around edges, 10-15 minutes. In the last 5 minutes of cook time, drizzle over the honey and balsamic vinegar. Return to the oven and roast until sticky.

Cook the chicken: Meanwhile, place your hand flat on top of chicken breast and slice through horizontally to make two thin steaks. In a medium bowl, combine tomato & herb seasoning, chicken steaks, a drizzle of olive oil and a pinch of salt and pepper. In a large frying pan, heat a drizzle of olive oil over medium-high heat. Cook chicken steaks until cooked through, 3-6 minutes each side (cook in batches if needed). TIP: Chicken is cooked through when it’s no longer pink inside.
Bring it all together: To the tray with roasted veggies, add baby spinach leaves. Gently toss to combine. Season to taste with salt and pepper.
Finish & serve: Slice chicken. Divide herby chicken, honey-balsamic Fioretto and veggie toss between plates. Serve with Italian truffle mayonnaise. Enjoy!
description: We’ve teamed up with Perfection Fresh, to bring you some superstar ingredients to level up your next meal. With tender stems and delicate florets, the creamy cauliflower will become the best part of this veggie medley. When paired with herby chicken and truffle mayo, you’ll be savouring each and every bite. Compliments to the Fioretto, we say!
utensils: Two oven trays lined with baking paper
proteinSwaps: BEEF RUMP: Cook, turning, for 3-4 minutes for medium-rare. Rest, then slice before serving.
SALMON: Cook over high heat with a drizzle of olive oil, skin-side down first, until just cooked through, 2-4 minutes each side.
CHICKEN BREAST: Follow method above, cooking in batches if necessary.
